lesson.menu_desc: Asking a man on the street where places are -- there is / there are + Where is...?
lesson.subtitle: Lesson 9 -- Where Is the Pharmacy?
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Eliane Zippo Guerreiro | Lesson 9 -- Where Is the Pharmacy?
lesson.pre_a1_modelo: Excuse me. Is there a pharmacy near here?

listenings.text: Welcome to Bay Tower. Near our building, there is a supermarket, there is a pharmacy, and there are two restaurants. The supermarket is on the right, on Bay Street. The pharmacy is on the left, at the corner. And there are buses to the beach every twenty minutes.

Hello, and thank you for calling Bay Pharmacy. We are on Ocean Street, at the corner of Fifth Avenue. There is a parking lot behind the pharmacy. We are open every day, from eight a.m. to ten p.m. There is a pharmacist here all day. Thank you.

extra_audio.text: Eliane says: Excuse me. She asks: Is there a pharmacy near here? Luis says: Yes, there is. He says: Go to the corner and turn left. Eliane says: Thank you so much!
